(function () {
    performance.mark('img-lazyloader-init');
    const IMG_SEL = 'img.responsive-img_img';
    const isMobile = newscorpau?.device === 'mobile';

    const shouldSetSizes = (img) => {
        if (isMobile) {
            const imageSize = img.parentElement?.getAttribute('data-desiredImageSize');
            if (imageSize === 'marketing_promo_image') {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    };

    const io = window.IntersectionObserver && new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        console.debug('[img_lazyloader] IO callback:', entries.length, 'entries', entries.filter(e => e.isIntersecting).length, 'intersecting');
        const updates = [];
        // batch read
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting && shouldSetSizes(entry.target)) {
                updates.push({ img: entry.target, width: entry.target.clientWidth });
                io.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
        });
        // batch write on next frame
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            updates.forEach(({ img, width }) => {
                if (width) {
                    img.sizes = width + 'px';
                }
            });
        });
    }, {
        rootMargin: '200px 0px'
    });

    const imgs = document.querySelectorAll(IMG_SEL);
    if (imgs) {
        // batch read
        const updates = [];
        imgs.forEach((img) => {
            if (shouldSetSizes(img)) {
                updates.push({ img, width: img.clientWidth });
            }
            io?.observe(img);
        });
        // batch write on next frame
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            updates.forEach(({ img, width }) => {
                if (width) {
                    img.sizes = width + 'px';
                }
            });
        });
    }
    performance.mark('img-lazyloader-end');
    performance.measure('img-lazyloader-duration', 'img-lazyloader-init', 'img-lazyloader-end');
})();
</script></body></html></esi:text>

(function () {
    performance.mark('img-lazyloader-init');
    const IMG_SEL = 'img.responsive-img_img';
    const isMobile = newscorpau?.device === 'mobile';

    const shouldSetSizes = (img) => {
        if (isMobile) {
            const imageSize = img.parentElement?.getAttribute('data-desiredImageSize');
            if (imageSize === 'marketing_promo_image') {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    };

    const io = window.IntersectionObserver && new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        console.debug('[img_lazyloader] IO callback:', entries.length, 'entries', entries.filter(e => e.isIntersecting).length, 'intersecting');
        const updates = [];
        // batch read
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting && shouldSetSizes(entry.target)) {
                updates.push({ img: entry.target, width: entry.target.clientWidth });
                io.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
        });
        // batch write on next frame
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            updates.forEach(({ img, width }) => {
                if (width) {
                    img.sizes = width + 'px';
                }
            });
        });
    }, {
        rootMargin: '200px 0px'
    });

    const imgs = document.querySelectorAll(IMG_SEL);
    if (imgs) {
        // batch read
        const updates = [];
        imgs.forEach((img) => {
            if (shouldSetSizes(img)) {
                updates.push({ img, width: img.clientWidth });
            }
            io?.observe(img);
        });
        // batch write on next frame
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            updates.forEach(({ img, width }) => {
                if (width) {
                    img.sizes = width + 'px';
                }
            });
        });
    }
    performance.mark('img-lazyloader-end');
    performance.measure('img-lazyloader-duration', 'img-lazyloader-init', 'img-lazyloader-end');
})();
</script></body></html></esi:text>

(function () {
    performance.mark('img-lazyloader-init');
    const IMG_SEL = 'img.responsive-img_img';
    const isMobile = newscorpau?.device === 'mobile';

    const shouldSetSizes = (img) => {
        if (isMobile) {
            const imageSize = img.parentElement?.getAttribute('data-desiredImageSize');
            if (imageSize === 'marketing_promo_image') {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    };

    const io = window.IntersectionObserver && new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        console.debug('[img_lazyloader] IO callback:', entries.length, 'entries', entries.filter(e => e.isIntersecting).length, 'intersecting');
        const updates = [];
        // batch read
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting && shouldSetSizes(entry.target)) {
                updates.push({ img: entry.target, width: entry.target.clientWidth });
                io.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
        });
        // batch write on next frame
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            updates.forEach(({ img, width }) => {
                if (width) {
                    img.sizes = width + 'px';
                }
            });
        });
    }, {
        rootMargin: '200px 0px'
    });

    const imgs = document.querySelectorAll(IMG_SEL);
    if (imgs) {
        // batch read
        const updates = [];
        imgs.forEach((img) => {
            if (shouldSetSizes(img)) {
                updates.push({ img, width: img.clientWidth });
            }
            io?.observe(img);
        });
        // batch write on next frame
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            updates.forEach(({ img, width }) => {
                if (width) {
                    img.sizes = width + 'px';
                }
            });
        });
    }
    performance.mark('img-lazyloader-end');
    performance.measure('img-lazyloader-duration', 'img-lazyloader-init', 'img-lazyloader-end');
})();
</script></body></html></esi:text>
